evidence.quote: A new JANSEN Q-Bic Plus infiltration and rainwater management system was installed for Opernhaus Zurich’s Kügeliloo warehouse on behalf of the city authorities.
JANSEN powerwave single-u ground source heat loops were used in order to achieve the required heat output from fewer and shorter boreholes.
The architects opted to update the large window areas in keeping with the style using a steel profile system which was developed by Jansen
Das Janisol Stahlprofilsystem in Form der verwendeten Janisol HI Fensterelemente sowie Janisol 2 EI30 Brandschutzschiebetüren decken die Anforderungen an die Gebäudehülle eines Forschungsgebäudes ab.
